title: Stiffness coefficient k
description: Essential: Correctly applies Hooke's law to the equilibrium at point B to derive k = 4mg/(5L₀).

title: Friction force constancy
description: Essential: Correctly states that the kinetic friction force remains constant during downward motion.

title: Kinetic friction coefficient μ
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the coefficient μ = 0.25 using energy conservation or force balance between C and D.

title: Maximum velocity v_m
description: Essential: Correctly determines the maximum speed during first ascent as v_m = √(5gL₀)/5.

title: Force equilibrium at B
description: Important: Identifies point B as a frictionless equilibrium and resolves tension components to relate T, mg, and geometry.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Applies energy conservation (or work-energy theorem) between points C and D, accounting for elastic potential and work done by friction.

title: Net force zero at max speed
description: Important: Recognizes that maximum speed occurs when net force is zero (acceleration zero) and sets up the correct force balance equation.

title: Normal force calculation
description: Optional: Correctly calculates the constant normal force from the horizontal component of rope tension as F' = kL₀.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly signs the work done by friction in the energy equation (should be negative for descent).

title: Misidentifies equilibrium points
description: Pitfall: Assumes maximum speed is at the bottom D or confuses the position of zero net force.
